g.text: Graph revision AD - ga_side: Vessel z 40..680; the graph gives no temperature for this unit - above 60 C the thermoplastic is CPVC, never metal (duty section 3, hold W12)
Graph revision AD - ga_side: A-VES holdup report: the vessel holds 104.1 L to 100 mm below the top weld; the duty states no holdup basis for this class, so no residence time is derived
Graph revision AD - ga_side: Duty basis: scrub liquor in to chlorate finish, cell-gas sparges in, chlorine out to the fluoro trains (VDF_SYN/TFE_SYN), liquor returned to leach
